تنتصبوا (form VIII)
# تَنْتَصِبُوا (tantaṣibū) /tan.ta.sˤi.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
# تُنْتَصَبُوا (tuntaṣabū) /tun.ta.sˤa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَصَبَ (intaṣaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
